status.summary: Veteran heavyweight contender on a three-fight win streak: a split decision over Jailton Almeida (UFC 321, Oct 25, 2025), a unanimous decision over Waldo Cortes Acosta (UFC 328, May 9, 2026; 30-27, 29-28, 29-28) and a unanimous decision over Rizvan Kuniev (UFC 333, Oct 24, 2026; 29-28, 30-27, 30-27). The streak began after a split-decision loss to Ciryl Gane (UFC 310, Dec 7, 2024) that 19 of 20 media scorers gave to Volkov. He is ranked #2 at heavyweight and asked Dana White for a title shot, but Gane vs Josh Hokit was booked instead; afterwards he said 'I'm not hunting for this title.' Daniel Cormier called him the next contender unless Tom Aspinall returns or Alex Pereira (who faces Sergei Pavlovich at UFC 335, Dec 12) wins spectacularly. No fight booked as of Nov 6, 2026 (on no UFC card in the ESPN schedule through Feb 2027). Pro record 41-11; UFC record 15-5. No current injury reported.
status.ranking: #2 heavyweight in both the Meta UFC rankings (updated Oct 31, 2026) and the UFC media-panel rankings (updated Nov 3, 2026), per ufcalendar.com; Wikipedia also lists #2 in the Meta rankings as of Oct 24, 2026

injuries.what: knee injury; withdrew from the UFC 308 rematch with Gane, which moved to UFC 310 (historical; no current injury reported as of Nov 6, 2026)

signature: long jab and straight right behind a 6 ft 7 in frame
low kicks to the lead leg (43 of 44 leg strikes vs Cortes Acosta in May 2026, 32 of 42 vs Pavlovich, 56 of 62 vs Gane in 2021)
front kick to the body (finished Walt Harris at UFC 254, logged as a front kick to the body)
body shots at range (18 of 20 body strikes vs Gane in 2024, 25 of 33 vs Kuniev)
short punches in the clinch (finishes of Fabricio Werdum in round 4 and Stefan Struve are logged as punches in the clinch)
occasional finish on the mat: Ezekiel choke from mount vs Tai Tuivasa (UFC 293)
weaknesses: wrestlers can hold him down: Curtis Blaydes landed 14 of 25 takedowns with 19:52 of control (UFC Fight Night, Jun 2020, UD loss), and Jailton Almeida landed 7 of 9 with 647 s of control (Volkov still won a split decision)
submitted by Tom Aspinall (armbar, round 1, 2022) after two takedowns
knocked out by Derrick Lewis with 11 seconds left in a fight he was leading 121-39 in significant strikes (UFC 229, 2018)
modest power for his size: 0.52 knockdowns per 100 head strikes landed career, and 8 of his 15 UFC wins went to decision
lost both fights to Ciryl Gane (UD 2021, SD 2024)
style.summary: A 6 ft 7 in kickboxer who fights at long range with a high-volume jab, straight right, low kicks, body kicks and front kicks, and wins on output over three rounds. He is hard to hurt (one KO loss in 20 UFC fights) but can be taken down and held by strong wrestlers.

moves.notes: Each group (head, body, leg) sums to 1. From the decayed sums in fighters.json his significant attempts go 65% head, 19% body, 17% legs (landed 49/26/25), and career attempts 71/16/13, so recent fights show more body and leg work. Body accuracy is 78% and leg accuracy 86% decayed, against 43% to the head. The head group leans on the jab and straight right (0.62 together), which are his range tools at 6 ft 7 in; the head kick (0.12) is a kickboxer's share. In the body group, bodystraight (0.40) stands in for his front kicks and straight punches to the body (the front kick finished Walt Harris), with roundhouse body kicks at 0.45. Leg kicks lean to the rear-leg outside/calf kick (43 of 44 vs Cortes Acosta). Knee 0.20 stands in for his clinch work (8 of 10 clinch strikes vs Kuniev; ufcstats does not say whether these were knees or punches, so no 'knees' tag); no spinning finishes are on record. ufcstats does not record technique types, so the within-group splits are judgment. Sources: data/derived/fighters.json; ufcstats per-fight totals in data/raw (snapshot 2026-10-31).

appearance.build: very tall and long (6 ft 7 in, 80 in reach, listed 250 lb per ufcstats); long-limbed and lean rather than bulky, little visible muscle definition (ESPN cutouts)
appearance.hair: light-brown to dark-blond hair, short at the sides with a longer top swept back and to one side (ESPN, Dec 2024 and Oct 2026)
appearance.tattoos: large Japanese-style black-and-grey piece over the right shoulder, upper arm and right pec: a tiger with cherry blossoms and waves (in the Oct 2026 ESPN shoot, absent in Dec 2024); colour (red/orange) tattoo work on the side of the ribcage (ESPN Dec 2024 and Oct 2026)
appearance.kit: red UFC compression (vale tudo) shorts with a dark-red pattern and crypto.com logo (Oct 2026 ESPN shoot); black-and-grey patterned UFC fight shorts (Dec 2024). Corner colour sets the shorts in the sim

engine_notes.note: In 5-round fights his landed rate relative to round 1 runs 1.00, 1.05, 0.94, 0.91, 0.64 (minute-weighted, 7 five-round fights): steady through round 4, then a drop in round 5.

Takedown defense 65% decayed and 71% career (opponents 30 of 102). Opponents' control is high: about 166 s per 15 min decayed and 194 s career, mostly from Blaydes (19:52 in 2020) and Almeida (647 s in 2025).
Chin: 2 knockdowns absorbed and 1 KO/TKO loss (Lewis, 2018) in 20 UFC fights, 0.44 knockdowns absorbed per 100 head strikes taken career.

Above-average volume: 8.2 significant attempts and 4.6 landed per minute decayed (heavyweight prior about 7.7 and 3.8), and he absorbs 3.0 per minute. Power per strike is low (0.34 knockdowns per 100 head strikes landed decayed), so his wins come by decision more often than not.
91% of his significant attempts come at distance (decayed). He rarely takes opponents down himself: 0.40 takedowns per 15 min decayed.
